heading: Export my data · Memory Passport
explainer: Download everything Cogeto knows for you: every fact with its status, provenance and full history, and your deletion receipts (still independently verifiable), in an open, documented, versioned format. Your memory is portable; leave whenever you want.
startFailed: Couldn't start the export. Try again.
formatNote: The format is open and documented at <path>docs/passport-schema/</path>. Anyone can read and verify a Passport with only the schema and the instance public key above.

includeOriginals.label: Include original files
includeOriginals.help: Attach the original bytes of files you uploaded (a full archive). Off by default. Provenance and metadata are always included either way.

status.expired: Expired (re-export to get a fresh copy)
